studies.title: The elephant
studies.caption: This Asian elephant carries food to its mouth with its trunk. Elephants were valued for work and war, while animals sent abroad could become celebrated royal gifts.
studies.prompt: Three-quarter full-body Asian elephant Elephas maximus feeding on vegetation at a South Asian forest clearing, small rounded ears, twin-domed head, gently convex back, natural short tusks, trunk curled towards mouth with grass. Four columnar legs and sound feet, no saddle or war gear, not African giant ears.
